
[yellow bold]-- DEPRECATION -- all_pin_modes.volt:2[/yellow bold]

Move `chip esp32` to volt.toml: chip = "esp32"

 [dim]1 |[/dim] 
 [dim]2 |[/dim] chip esp32
 [dim]  |[/dim] [yellow]     ^^^^^[/yellow]

[cyan]Hint: The chip declaration will move to volt.toml in a future version.[/cyan]


[yellow bold]-- HARDWARE WARNING -- all_pin_modes.volt:5[/yellow bold]

Strapping pin: GPIO 0 must be HIGH during boot (pulled up by default). If driven LOW externally, the chip enters bootloader mode.

 [dim]4 |[/dim]     pin led: Output = 2
 [dim]5 |[/dim]     pin btn: PullUpInput = 0
 [dim]  |[/dim] [yellow]        ^^^[/yellow]
